## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (security fixes include a test that reproduces the issue)
- [ ] `composer lint`, `composer analyse` and `composer test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, setup or a decision changed (README, ADR, `docs/metrics.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or debug code committed
